module_summary: Serial accumulator: a 2-bit counter groups four accepted 8-bit inputs, the output register sums them, and valid_out pulses one cycle with each 4-sample sum.

anchors.name: data_out
anchors.why: 10-bit accumulator output: loads first sample, adds next three data_in values.

anchors.name: valid_out
anchors.why: One-cycle pulse when the fourth sample is accumulated, marking data_out valid.

anchors.name: valid_in
anchors.why: Input data-valid; enables accumulation and counting via ready_add.

anchors.name: count
anchors.why: Counts accepted samples 0-3; selects load vs add and triggers end_cnt.

anchors.name: ready_add
anchors.why: Accept enable (valid_in or not valid_out) gating counter and accumulator updates.

anchors.name: end_cnt
anchors.why: Terminal count: wraps count and sets valid_out.

groups.name: sample_counter
groups.description: Accept logic and mod-4 sample counter generating the output valid pulse.

groups.name: accumulator
groups.description: Adds incoming samples; data_out_reg is an unread duplicate accumulator.
